target.title: fix(gateway): clear session suspension timers on shutdown
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #101720.

`session-suspension.ts` schedules lane auto-resume timers that later call `setCommandLaneConcurrency()`. Before this change, those timers were owned only by the session-suspension module and were not cleared by the gateway shutdown path, so a pending TTL callback could still mutate command-lane concurrency after shutdown started tearing down sidecars, plugin services, channels, queues, and runtimes.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a narrow lifecycle cleanup instead of changing suspension semantics:

- export `clearSessionSuspensionTimers()` from `session-suspension.ts`
- clear all pending lane auto-resume timers during gateway close
- run the cleanup before post-ready sidecars, plugin services, and channels stop
- keep normal TTL auto-resume behavior unchanged

## User Impact

Gateway shutdown/restart no longer leaves pending session-suspension auto-resume callbacks behind. In source-level terms, cleanup changes the pending auto-resume timer count from `1 -> 0`, and advancing the TTL after cleanup no longer calls `setCommandLaneConcurrency()`.

## Evidence

Focused regression proof:

- `session-suspension.test.ts` schedules a lane auto-resume timer, calls `clearSessionSuspensionTimers()`, then advances fake time past the TTL and asserts no lane concurrency mutation occurs.
- `server-close.test.ts` asserts gateway shutdown calls the cleanup before sidecars, plugin services, and channels stop.

Validation run on Node 24 after rebasing on latest `upstream/main` (`3f68e1b5e3a`):

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/agents/session-suspension.test.ts src/gateway/server-close.test.ts
# passed: gateway shard 86 tests, agents shard 7 tests

OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 node scripts/check-changed.mjs --base upstream/main --timed
# passed: core/coreTests lanes, typecheck, test typecheck, lint changed files, runtime sidecar loader guard, import cycles, database/pairing/webhook guards

node scripts/build-all.mjs
# passed; total 225.1s, slowest tsdown 216.9s
```

## AI-assisted

I used an AI coding assistant to inspect the issue path, implement the focused patch, and run the validation commands above. I reviewed the resulting diff and tests before opening this PR.

Signed-off-by: Ho Lim <subhoya@gmail.com>
